knobs.title: Starting Trainer level
knobs.varianceRationale: Campaigns legitimately start above level 1; higher levels unlock milestone choices, more Features/Edges, and larger stat budgets that validation must scale automatically.

knobs.title: Trainer stat budget
knobs.varianceRationale: Fixed canonical math. Recording it here documents that the matrix deliberately does NOT expose it; house-ruled budgets are out of alpha scope.

knobs.title: Starting money
knobs.canonicalConstraint: non-negative integer; canonical default baseline arrives with DATA-ONB-002
knobs.shippedDefault: canonical baseline once DATA-ONB-002 lands; policy may override explicitly
knobs.varianceRationale: Wealthy or destitute campaign openings are common table variation.

knobs.title: Starting inventory package
knobs.canonicalConstraint: every entry resolves to a canonical items.json identity; serialized equipment uses Plan 8 authority
knobs.varianceRationale: Standard kits (Poké Balls, Potions, camping gear) vary per campaign and should be one reviewed package application, not per-character retyping.

knobs.title: Starting equipment grants
knobs.canonicalConstraint: equipment instances created only through Plan 8 equipment authority
knobs.varianceRationale: Some campaigns begin with weapons/armor; equipment must never be legacy prose slots.

knobs.title: Permitted Feature/Edge/class sources
knobs.canonicalConstraint: allow/deny lists reference canonical feature and edge IDs or tags only
knobs.varianceRationale: Tables restrict classes or ban specific options; restrictions must be explicit ID/tag lists, not hidden filters.

knobs.title: Number of starters
knobs.varianceRationale: Multi-starter campaigns exist; team size and overflow destinations must stay explicit.

knobs.title: Starter species pool
knobs.canonicalConstraint: entries are exact Pokédex row identities (DATA-ONB-003); sparse rows fail closed
knobs.varianceRationale: The most common campaign variation; curated trios, regional lists, or open choice.

knobs.title: Starter level
knobs.varianceRationale: Table convention differs; the shipped default is a product policy value, not a canonical PTU claim.

knobs.title: Move sources at creation
knobs.canonicalConstraint: level-up list is always legal; TM/tutor additions must reference canonical machine/tutor compatibility
knobs.varianceRationale: Some campaigns allow one egg/TM move at creation; must be explicit and validated.

knobs.title: Starter held items
knobs.canonicalConstraint: canonical item identity + custody through item authority
knobs.varianceRationale: Held-item starts vary; custody must be single-owner at commit.

knobs.title: Caught-ball metadata and ball inventory
knobs.canonicalConstraint: ball identity from items.json when recorded
knobs.shippedDefault: standard Poké Ball metadata, no inventory consumption
knobs.varianceRationale: Presentation-level convention with optional inventory linkage.

knobs.title: Starting Loyalty
knobs.canonicalConstraint: canonical default arrives with DATA-ONB-004; bounded override only
knobs.varianceRationale: Some tables start loyal companions higher; must stay a bounded numeric policy.

knobs.title: Optional unresolved choices at submission
knobs.canonicalConstraint: hard rules can never be deferred; only explicitly optional decisions may remain open
knobs.varianceRationale: Some GMs allow deferring flavor or single optional picks to session zero; blocking issues are never deferrable.

knobs.title: Approval requirement
knobs.canonicalConstraint: approval is always an explicit GM action in alpha; auto-approve is out of scope
knobs.varianceRationale: Recorded to keep the boundary explicit; the matrix documents that this knob intentionally does not vary yet.

knobs.title: Committed sheet folder destinations
knobs.canonicalConstraint: valid folder paths; player-accessible folder semantics respected
knobs.varianceRationale: Libraries are organized differently per table; destination must be policy, not per-commit improvisation.

knobs.title: Milestone choice collection for higher-level starts
knobs.varianceRationale: Some tables prefer resolving milestone choices in session; deferral routes them into existing campaign attention.

knobs.title: Evolution-stage restriction for the pool
knobs.canonicalConstraint: stage data from pokedex.evolutions; rows with unknown stage fail closed when restricted
knobs.varianceRationale: First-stage-only starters are a common convention layered on any pool mode.
